LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: READING Theme 4: Time (Moments of the day) Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning O
Topic 2.6: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of READING Theme 4: Time (Moments of the day) Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning O in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How do we get all the needed information from a reading text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read names of meals and mealtimes as guided from audio,

2. read short and simple texts on different meal times at home/school, (z.B Frühstück, Mittagessen, Abendessen, Tee/Kaffeepause) and match to given pictures,

3. read sentences on mealtimes and dishes with peers,

4. read online texts on foods and menus from Kenya and Germany and share in plenary.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read names of meals and mealtimes as guided from audio,
2. read short and simple texts on different meal times at home/school, (z.B Frühstück, Mittagessen, Abendessen, Tee/Kaffeepause) and match to given pictures,
3. read sentences on mealtimes and dishes with peers,
4. read online texts on foods and menus from Kenya and Germany and share in plenary.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: Learner demonstrates appreciation of foods and mealtimes from different regions of the world as they read

online texts on food and menus from Kenya/Germany

Values:
Patriotism: learner demonstrates awareness and love for foods and mealtimes as they read texts on Menus from Kenya

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Healthy Eating: Learner develops an awareness of healthy eating as they read short and simple texts on different meal times at

home/school, (z.B Frühstück, Mittagessen, Abendessen, Tee/Kaffeepause) and match to given pictures.

Link to other Learning Areas

Learner links their knowledge of healthy eating in agriculture to this sub strand.
